messages:
Sarah M.: Quick q — vendor pushed our UK‑west H100 rack ETA from Tue -> Thu. Does that break the quiet-window reservation for next week's burst? Need to decide if we keep the demo reserve or try to borrow EU-west. /cc @Tim P.
Tim P.: Procurement saw the update. Vendor now says ship Thu 05:00 UTC, partner needs ~24h to stage, so usable Fri morning earliest. For the demo reserve itself we should be fine, but migrations during quiet-window are risky.
Lucas O.: Oncall note: what's the quiet-window window again? I see two entries in the infra calendar. Which one applies to the demo cluster?
Jordan K.: The demo cluster quiet-window is Mon 02:00-06:00 UTC next Tuesday slot (we left a recurring entry). That's probably overlapping with their staging if they arrive Fri -> shouldn't collide. But if we start disruptive canaries Fri night we could impact other tenants.
Tim P.: Short plan: keep the current reserve for demo, but don't kick off canary migrations until after Fri 12:00 UTC. If Sarah wants EU-west fallback, we can swap to a standby slice — costs +20% for cross-region. I'll open a PO-change note now.
vendor-bot: Shipment update: ETA=2025-10-17T05:00:00Z, Tracking=TRACK-UKWEST-9981. Staging ETA estimate +24h.
Sarah M.: OK, that timeline works. Tim, please open the PO-change and tag finance. Jordan/Lucas can you update the quiet-window doc to call out 'no disruptive canaries until Fri 12:00 UTC' and add a short rollback checklist?
Jordan K.: Will do — I'll add the rollback checklist and link to the canary runbook.
Lucas O.: Added a note in the quiet-window doc and pinged #oncall-ops with the tentative Fri 12:00 start. If vendor updates ETA I'll update the doc.
Tim P.: PO-change ticket opened: PO-3421, cc finance@redwood. If we do EU-west standby it'll be charged to the demo budget; finance flagged the +20% earlier.
Sarah M.: Thanks all — ping here if vendor moves again. :thumbsup:
